Name: TT's Photo frame(CP)
Author: tforly
Description:
[b][size=5][center]

制作了可爱的相框，可以在游戏中与喜欢的人合影啦！

两个相框是装饰品，配了两块背景地毯。

它们是CP新增的家具，可以在家具目录中找到！

I have created a cute photo frame that allows me to take photos with people I like in the game!
Two photo frames are decors, accompanied by two background rugs
They are newly added furniture by CP and can be found in the furniture catalog![/center][/size][/b][center][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/e/e8/Furniture_Catalogue.png[/img]
